description.narrative: Blue Crane is a growing social venture taking active in the development of certified, organic oils and specialty lipid solutions. They have embarked on a journey to build long-term partnerships sourcing predominantly from African based processors. They have established three local processing partners for a reliable supply chain of (organic) high quality fair trade certified Sheabutter, Cocoabutter and virgin Coconut oil. Their sourcing projects in Ivory Coast, Kenya and Ghana will directly benefit local producers, and aim to support and enable local processors to further strengthen their businesses, quality and traceability. Blue Crane further processes, packages and distributes this as part of its specialty lipid portfolio to customers globally.

Cadesa – feasibility study for local cocoa processing facility

description.narrative: The IA financial contribution supports a feasibility study for the development of a local cocoa processing facility in Côte d’Ivoire. The project assesses the technical and commercial viability of processing cocoa beans locally. Once implemented, local processing is expected to enable value addition, increase farmer income, and improve resilience of the cocoa value chain. The study will provide a clear view on the viability of the business case and enable future scale-up and investment.
